picks.name: Gold Panda
picks.source_note: Already in your library. Dry research day -- caught two near-miss duplicates before settling here (Oceanic's "ICI" and Hodge's "Big Splash" were both already published in August and October). This is a genuine new-to-the-pool discovery for this artist, about five months old rather than brand new. Exact Bandcamp album-page slug unconfirmable via search (though a fan's public collection confirms it's sold there), so the purchase link points to his confirmed-live Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "TON UP" (June 26, 2026, Studio Barnhus) is Gold Panda's (Derwin Schlecker) new full-length, following 2023's The Work -- eight rough-hewn dance tracks and two shorter interludes, led by the single "Ding The Motor," sticking to his sampler-heavy, textured production style.
picks.why_listen: A sampler-warped, dance-leaning side of a producer usually filed under headphone electronica -- good for a textural, rhythmically off-kilter stretch of a set.
